sources: Configured fixed keys, custom environment names, optional credentials, and automatically rotated keys shall resolve deterministically.
A configured fixed key resolves through its configured custom environment name.
A missing required credential raises the public missing-key error with identity.
structured.test_focus: Call candidates with a fixed key_id (e.g. 2) whose custom environment name is set while other keys also exist, and check that exactly that one key is returned from its configured env name. Also check that when that fixed key is missing, ApiKeyNotFoundError reports key 2 and its env var, not the default key.
